name: Hedge Maze Hoodwink
source:
After exchanging letters, you have arrived at the hedge maze to meet your anonymous lover at sunset. Except now that you're here, you have to actually find them in this maze. To make matters worse, you keep running into a homicidal stranger who doesn't seem to care how much of a rush you're in!

[From [url=https://cygni.itch.io/hedge-maze-hoodwink]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
互通信件后，你在日落时分来到树篱迷宫，准备和匿名的恋人见面。可现在你到了地方，却得先在迷宫里找到对方。更糟的是，你不断撞见一个杀人狂陌生人，似乎根本不在乎你有多着急！

[来源：[url=https://cygni.itch.io/hedge-maze-hoodwink]Itch.io[/url]]
